title: Feedback Request 1
description: Feedback to the makers, forwarded to the Mayor. Two kinds: grammar-approach (Ask for another approach, with pictures attached) and tutor-ask (an ask the tutor could not meet, sent by his tap on Send this to the makers).

kind.description: grammar-approach asks for another way of teaching Greek grammar.

text.description: What approach he wants and how it teaches, in his words.

name.description: Who made the approach, so the factory can credit them.

url.description: A link to the approach, when there is one.

app_version.description: The Lampas build he sent it from.

kind.description: tutor-ask is something he asked the tutor for that Lampas does not do (work with another app, a new setting, a change); the tutor offered to pass it on and he tapped Send this to the makers.

text.description: What he asked the tutor, in his words.

summary.description: The tutor's one-line summary of the ask.

screen.description: The screen he asked from: its name, or Reader for a talk about the text.

reference.description: What the talk was about: the screen's name, or the chapter or verse (Romans 8:28).

facts.description: What the screen showed him, as the tutor was told it. Left out when the talk was about the text.

app_version.description: The Lampas build he sent it from.
